title: A flat point of a finite module over a Noetherian base has a flat basic neighborhood
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $R\to S$ a finite-type homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and $M$ a finitely generated $S$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $\mathfrak q\subset S$ be prime. If $M_{\mathfrak q}$, the localization at $S\setminus\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], is flat as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then there exists $g\in S\setminus\mathfrak q$ such that for every prime $\mathfrak q'\subset S$ with $g\notin\mathfrak q'$, the $R$-module $M_{\mathfrak q'}$ is flat. Thus the basic Zariski open $D(g)=\{\mathfrak q':g\notin\mathfrak q'\}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is contained in the flat locus.
